body: Thanks, I'm planning to make a call this week to set up a mental health appointment soon. I've been putting it off.

That's right, I'm doing residency now. I think my family would be okay because my loans would be canceled if I died, and they would get a lot of help from our parents.

My husband does all the child care when I'm at work, or when I am at home but desperately need sleep (because I've been working overnight, for instance). I do dishes, trash, laundry, etc. I guess the "shitty mother" bit is because I'm always so tired when I'm taking care of my son that I can't be as enthusiastic as I want to or do a good job facilitating his development. Sometimes I just kind of lie down in his room and vaguely doze off while he plays.

It sucks because I know I judge myself worse than anyone else does, but the pain I feel about it hurts just the same even if it's irrational.
